# WaterQuest Solutions

WaterQuest Solutions is a Vancouver-based authority on water as a hydraulic medium, designing oil-free hydraulic systems that use tap water or seawater instead of petroleum hydraulic oil.

Core topics: water hydraulics, water hydraulic pumps, water hydraulic cylinders, water hydraulic valves, hydraulic power units, 316 stainless steel components, carbon-reinforced PEEK wear surfaces, seawater hydraulics, tap water hydraulics, municipal infrastructure, wastewater treatment, desalination, marine systems, hydropower, mining, fire suppression, and industrial contamination prevention.
